build_gaussian_smearing: build a GaussianSmearing module to encode atom distances using Gaussian basis functions with configurable start, stop, and width
build_sigmoid_smearing: build a SigmoidSmearing module to encode atom distances using sigmoid basis functions with configurable parameters
build_linear_sigmoid_smearing: build a LinearSigmoidSmearing module to encode atom distances using sigmoid plus linear residual basis functions
build_silu_smearing: build a SiLUSmearing module to encode atom distances using a learnable linear layer with SiLU activation
test_smearing_forward: test the forward pass of any smearing class by passing a distance tensor and verifying output shape
